climate.notice: Public CMIP6 HighResMIP projections via Open-Meteo, ERA5-Land bias correction enabled. Near-RCP8.5 forcing; not an SSP scenario ensemble. Two-model spread is not a probability interval or full uncertainty estimate. Ten-year windows are illustrative, not 30-year climate normals. Only two representative locations; no farm-scale projections.

benchmark.notice: 2018 April–September comparison with ERA5-Land modeled 0–1 m storage. Uses ERA5/ERA5-Land seamless forcing and the same soil reanalysis for initialization: a diagnostic benchmark, not independent observational validation or held-out crop-yield validation. Generic Kc/capacity; snow starts zero; no irrigation/calibration.
